ideas.title: The Impact of Medicaid Fraud on Local Autism Centers
ideas.description: This story would investigate the effects of the Medicaid fraud crackdown on local autism centers in Minnesota, including the funding crisis and potential solutions.
ideas.angle: The human impact of Medicaid fraud
questions: What are the specific effects on local autism centers?
How are families and individuals affected?
ideas.insight: This story could shed light on the real-world consequences of Medicaid fraud and potential solutions to mitigate the impact.

ideas.title: Uncovering the CATS Corruption Probe
ideas.description: This story would delve into the details of the CATS corruption probe, including potential wrongdoing and the impact on Minnesota communities.
ideas.insight: This story could provide insight into potential corruption in Minnesota programs and the efforts to address it.
